senses.gloss:
Ūrdara. — This word occurs once in the Rigveda,^1 when
reference is made to filling Indra with Soma as one fills an
[]
Ūrdara with grain (Yava). Sāyaṇa renders it granāry, but
Roth^2 and Zimmer^3 seem more correct in simply making it a
measure for holding grain, or ‘garner.’
1) ii. 14, 11.
2) St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
3) Altindisches Leben, 238.
